summary: The agent played the coin system for about 7.5 minutes over 4 episodes. It collected the coins in several orders, by walking into them and by jumping at them (both early and late jumps), and walked back over every spot where a coin had been taken. It also died by walking off the baseplate edge while holding a coin, then collected the rest after respawning. The coin system behaved as coded every time: each pickup raised leaderstats Coins by exactly that coin's Value (Coin3 is worth 2, the others 1, for 6 in all), no coin counted twice, the count survived death and respawn, and the door opened the moment the count reached 5. No coin bugs showed up in play. Two smaller problems: the HUD never shows the coin count or the 5-coin target ("Collect the coins" the whole time), and the sign meant to explain the target errors at start.
evidence: trace1-4: the harness checked every change of the count against the Value of the coins that vanished in the same frame, and the door state against count>=5. 0 mismatches over 4 full collections (anomalies: [] in each status evidence)
trace1.jsonl: Coin5 t=4.3 (1), Coin1 t=10.1 (2), Coin3 t=14.7 (4, delta 2), Coin2 t=20.4 (5, the door opens in the same reading), Coin4 t=40.4 (6)
trace1/2/4 walk_over_taken_spots (6 passes, 3-4 spots each): the count never changed and no coin came back

trace3.jsonl: 4 jumps at coins. The early take-off (260 cm out) picked up Coin1, Coin4 and Coin2, and the late take-off (120 cm out) picked up Coin3: no jump passed over a coin uncollected. Each counted its Value once (1, 3, 4, 5, 6)

trace4.jsonl: Coins=1 at t=2.7. The player walked off the baseplate edge, fell below -3000 cm at t=72.5, respawned at spawn (0,0) at t=76.8 with Coins still 1 and the door still closed, then collected Coin2/Coin4/Coin5/Coin3 to 2, 3, 4, 6 (t=84-175)
Every episode: Hud.Status read 'Collect the coins' throughout and never showed the count or the target, even after all 6 coins
Game log, every episode at t=0.0: [Error] Workspace.Sign.SignText:3: attempt to index nil with 'TextLabel'; [Warning] ContentId rbxassetid://203785492 asset type mismatch
findings: The HUD gives no coin feedback. Hud.Status stays 'Collect the coins' from start to finish (after 0, 5 and all 6 coins, in all 4 episodes). It never shows the count, the 5-coin target, or that the door opened. The only count is leaderstats.

The sign that should explain the coin target ('Collect 5 coins to open the door') never shows. SignText.server.luau:3 errors at start because /Workspace/Sign has no SurfaceGui, so the player is never told the door needs 5 coins (game log, every episode).

A design note, not a broken rule: since Coin3 is worth 2, the door opens with 4 of the 5 coins (trace1 t=20.4 and trace2 t=16.0: count 5, one coin left). The last coin is then optional. This matches the code (NEEDED = 5 on the value total).
